description:
Stable machine codes with display labels. A code the UI does not know must stay VISIBLE through a readable fallback — rendered from its own text — rather than being dropped or shown as 'unknown error'. A producer is free to emit a code this version has never seen; that is why the schema's pattern is permissive and why consumers must implement the fallback.

The fallback: replace separators with spaces and show the code verbatim beside it, so an operator can grep the producer for it.

codes.source.missing: No source of this kind was found
codes.source.unreadable: A source could not be read
codes.source.invalid-json: A source was not valid JSON
codes.source.summary-truncated: The Observer summary was missing sections
codes.source.summary-only: Only a summary was available; no client samples
codes.source.late-arrival: A source arrived after this generation was computed
codes.source.replaced: A source was replaced by a corrected version
codes.source.duplicate-sfu-observation: The same observation arrived from more than one SFU
codes.coverage.gap-exceeds-max-interval: A sampling gap exceeded the maximum supported interval
codes.coverage.cadence-unknown: Expected sampling cadence could not be established
codes.coverage.expected-sources-unknown: How many sources to expect could not be established
codes.coverage.partial-population: Some calls or participants have unknown start times
codes.coverage.child-period-missing: A child period was not evaluated
codes.metric.counter-reset: A counter reset or was corrected
codes.metric.denominator-zero: The denominator was zero, so no rate can be reported
codes.metric.remote-report-stale: The remote report's timestamp had not advanced
codes.metric.no-valid-intervals: No interval met the policy's validity rules
codes.metric.out-of-domain: An observation fell outside the metric's legal range and was rejected
codes.metric.overflow: A total exceeded the safe integer range
codes.metric.not-supported-by-producer: This producer does not report the required fields
codes.eligibility.context-unknown: Track context was unknown, so eligibility could not be decided
codes.temporal.resolution-insufficient: Evidence localises this only to a sampling interval
codes.temporal.clock-uncertainty-exceeded: Clock uncertainty was too large to correlate clients
codes.temporal.clock-uncertainty-unbounded: Clock uncertainty could not be bounded
codes.identity.unverified: Identity could not be verified, so records were not merged
codes.identity.epoch-reused: A stat ID was reused after a reconnect
codes.topology.relationship-unverified: No verified evidence links publisher and subscriber
codes.path.on-change-metadata-insufficient: Retained on-change metadata cannot establish the selected path
codes.cohort.interval-ambiguous: The serving path was ambiguous, so exposure went to the unknown cohort
codes.joins.adapter-missing: No versioned application attempt feed is configured
codes.joins.attempt-unassigned: The attempt is not yet associated with a call
codes.lifecycle.open: The call is still open, so figures are provisional
codes.lifecycle.evidence-missing: No lifecycle evidence of sufficient authority was found
codes.read.pending: Processing has not produced this digest yet
codes.read.not-found: Nothing has been written for this subject
codes.read.unsupported-version: The stored document uses a schema version this dashboard does not support
codes.read.forbidden: Not authorized for this tenant or resource
codes.read.cursor-expired: The cursor was issued against a revision that is no longer served
codes.read.cursor-mismatch: The cursor does not match the requested filters
codes.read.revision-superseded: A newer revision was published while this one was being read
codes.read.stale-revision: The served revision is usable but known to lag
codes.policy.capability-disabled: This category is disabled by policy
codes.policy.inputs-unavailable: The policy's required inputs are not available
